We are looking for a full stack developer to join Contoso Retail (fictional company). You will work on our customer portal using React and Node.js, writing clean TypeScript and building APIs that talk to a PostgreSQL database. You should be comfortable writing unit tests with Jest, reviewing code, and deploying containerized services with Docker. Familiarity with Azure is a plus, and exposure to Kafka would be nice. The ideal candidate has at least 3 years of experience shipping production web applications and communicates clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
